remarks: Welcome to SoNo Lofts - unit 107. Located in historic South Norwalk within easy walking distance to amazing shopping, entertainment, restaurants, Maritime Aquarium, and Veteran's Park. Also, just a short ride to the beautiful Norwalk Beaches. Modern first floor Studio apartment with open floor plan boasting 10ft ceilings, oversized windows allowing natural light into the unit. Open kitchen with exceptional storage. Covenant in-unit laundry closet, large bath and oversized bedroom storage closet. Unit comes with a storage area for your extra belongings located in the lower level of the building. Amenities include a full gym, bicycle storage, and private gated parking. There is plenty of open visitor parking for your guests. Easy access to Metro-North Railroad and I95 Highway for easy up or down county commuting.
